类型名: Sub-peg collateral lets users mint/issue the stablecoin (or redeem) at par, arbitraging the peg deviation against backers
漏洞名称: RTokens can be purchased at a discount
漏洞示例: RToken.issue only reverts when a collateral's status is DISABLED (`require(status != CollateralStatus.DISABLED)`). If a collateral is IFFY (price temporarily decreased but not defaulted), a user can create a large non-atomic issuance, sending the cheap collateral now during issue() while the RToken vests later after the price recovers to SOUND, effectively buying RTokens at a discount. Resolved by allowing issuance only when the basket status is SOUND.

类型名: Self-referential backing valuation corrupts the unit-of-account's own price
漏洞名称: RToken should be refreshed
漏洞示例: For assets where price() may return stale prices (sDAI, CToken), refresh() makes necessary calls (drip(), exchangeRateCurrent()). RTokenAsset.refresh() does not update the RToken state (assetRegistry.refresh(), Furnace.melt()), so tryPrice() may use stale RToken collateral prices and totalSupply.

类型名: Self-referential backing valuation corrupts the unit-of-account's own price
漏洞名称: CurveStableMetapoolCollateral should override refresh() function
漏洞示例: CurveStableRTokenMetapoolCollateral is a Metapool whose pairedToken is RToken, but its refresh() does not call pairedAssetRegistry.toAsset(pairedToken).refresh() / RToken.refresh(). Without that the collateral uses RToken's stale state (price), and as in M-7 RToken.price() likely returns a stale price.

类型名: Collateral-refresh revert bricks the whole peg-keeping engine
漏洞名称: refresh() will revert on Oracle deprecation, effectively disabling part of the protocol
漏洞示例: Asset.refresh()/FiatCollateral catch all tryPrice() errors except empty-data errors (intentionally, to avoid OOG griefing). But Chainlink deprecates feeds by setting aggregator to address(0), which makes the call revert with empty data, so refresh() reverts. Any function refreshing assets (issuance, vesting, redemption, manageTokens, StRSR.withdraw) then fails until governance replaces the asset (~7 days).

类型名: Degenerate oracle-failure price (0 / FIX_MAX) triggers fire-sale of the reserve
漏洞名称: Shortfall might be calculated incorrectly if a price value for one collateral isn't fetched correctly
漏洞示例: Asset.price() returns (0, FIX_MAX) instead of reverting when pricing is unavailable. RecollateralizationLib.collateralShortfall (L449) does not validate the returned price before using priceHigh, so `shortfall = shortfall.plus(needed.minus(held).mul(priceHigh, CEIL))` can use FIX_MAX and overflow/misvalue the shortfall (e.g. via a nested RTokenAsset with a broken oracle).

类型名: Mint-input vs collateral-received mismatch creates unbacked stablecoin supply
漏洞名称: CBEthCollateral and AnkrStakedEthCollateral _underlyingRefPerTok is incorrect
漏洞示例: CBEthCollateral._underlyingRefPerTok() uses CBEth.exchangeRate() (cbETH/staked-ETH2) as the ref/tok rate, but the ref unit should be ETH. Since staked ETH2 carries an unstake premium, the returned ref/tok is higher than the truth, letting an attacker issue more rTokens; the collateral never marks DISABLED. Same bug in AnkrStakedEthCollateral and RethCollateral.

类型名: Degenerate oracle-failure price (0 / FIX_MAX) triggers fire-sale of the reserve
漏洞名称: CurveStableMetapoolCollateral.tryPrice returns a huge but valid high price when the price oracle of pairedToken is timeout
漏洞示例: In CurveStableMetapoolCollateral.tryPrice, this.tryPairedPrice() is wrapped in an empty try/catch; on oracle timeout highPaired defaults to FIX_MAX. _metapoolBalancesValue then sets aumHigh to FIX_MAX, and high = aumHigh.div(supply, CEIL) yields a huge-but-valid (< FIX_MAX) price, causing severe mispricing in reward/rebalance auctions.

类型名: Degenerate oracle-failure price (0 / FIX_MAX) triggers fire-sale of the reserve
漏洞名称: RTokenAsset price oracle can return a huge but valid high price when any underlying collateral's price oracle timeout
漏洞示例: When an underlying collateral oracle times out, BasketHandler._price feeds FIX_MAX highP into safeMul (returns FIX_MAX), so highBUPrice=FIX_MAX. RToken.tryPrice computes high = range.top.mulDiv(highBUPrice, supply, CEIL); if range.top < supply it does not overflow, and _updateCachedPrice stores oracle price ~FIX_MAX/2 instead of reverting, grossly mispricing the RToken as a price feed.

类型名: Degenerate oracle-failure price (0 / FIX_MAX) triggers fire-sale of the reserve
漏洞名称: Oracle timeout at rebalance will result in a sell-off of all RSRs at 0 price
漏洞示例: In RecollateralizationLibP1.nextTradePair the RSR sell price comes from rsrAsset.price(), which returns (0, FIX_MAX) on oracle timeout. With low=0, prepareTradeSell is used instead of prepareTradeToCoverDeficit, so trade.sellAmount = all RSR in BackingManager + stRSR is auctioned at a 0 price, losing a huge amount of RSR.

类型名: Self-referential backing valuation corrupts the unit-of-account's own price
漏洞名称: Sell reward rTokens at low price because of skipping furnace.melt
漏洞示例: RevenueTraderP1.manageToken only refreshes and calls furnace.melt() if assetRegistry.lastRefresh() != block.timestamp. An actor can call assetRegistry.refresh() first in the same block so melt() is skipped; the RToken BU exchange rate is then stale-low, so sellPrice = sell.price() is understated and reward rTokens are auctioned below value, hurting RSR stakers.

类型名: Degenerate oracle-failure price (0 / FIX_MAX) triggers fire-sale of the reserve
漏洞名称: An oracle deprecation might lead the protocol to sell assets for a low price
漏洞示例: During a Dutch auction, bid() calls settleTrade() which calls rebalance() in a try/catch that treats empty error data as out-of-gas and reverts. A deprecated Chainlink oracle (aggregator set to zero address) makes latestRoundData revert with empty data, so all bids revert until a new asset is registered; an executor can then bid at the end at an unfairly low decayed price.

类型名: Peg-stabilizing reserve mints fresh stablecoin to cover liquidation losses, creating an inflationary insolvency cascade
漏洞名称: _finishChallenge Spec/Code Mismatch — Interest Not Separated from Bid
漏洞示例: MintingHub._finishChallenge at L312 transfers only `offer` from the bidder (DEURO.transferFrom(msg.sender, this, offer)) instead of `offer + interest` as the README specifies. Interest and principal repayment compete from the same `offer` pool, so underfunded liquidations drain coverLoss/reserve more than the spec implies.

类型名: Liquidation evasion/blocking on an undercollateralized position leaves it open to keep minting unbacked stablecoin
漏洞名称: Successfully Challenged Positions May Not Close
漏洞示例: A position only closes when `balance < minimumCollateral && challengedAmount == 0`. An attacker keeps a position from closing by starting a second overlapping challenge so challengedAmount never reaches 0 after a successful challenge. The minting restriction resets, and the attacker can repeatedly deposit collateral and mint the position's `limit` of ZCHF at the inflated liquidationPrice she set, minting undercollateralized ZCHF and causing system losses; repeatable infinitely.

类型名: Liquidation evasion/blocking on an undercollateralized position leaves it open to keep minting unbacked stablecoin
漏洞名称: Challenges of Expired Loans Can Be Averted
漏洞示例: In the V3 dutch-auction design, users can postpone repayment of expired positions indefinitely as long as the liquidationPrice stays below market price, because challenges on expired positions can be averted, making challengers take a loss. Fixed in V4 by capping phase-1 duration by the position's expiration so an expired position immediately enters phase 2.

类型名: System-wide recovery-mode / global-LTV solvency trigger weaponized to liquidate healthy collateral
漏洞名称: Shrine's recovery mode can be weaponized as leverage to liquidate healthy troves
漏洞示例: Recovery mode triggers when shrine LTV reaches 70% of the nominal threshold (is_recovery_mode_helper: health.ltv >= health.threshold * RECOVERY_MODE_THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER). scale_threshold_for_recovery_mode lowers thresholds, exposing previously-healthy troves to liquidation. An attacker (e.g. via flash loan) can open a large position to push global LTV above 70%, forcing recovery mode and liquidating lucrative troves within a single transaction, then close the bad position risk-free.

类型名: Liquidation evasion/blocking on an undercollateralized position leaves it open to keep minting unbacked stablecoin
漏洞名称: buyExpiredCollateral Can Disincentivize Challenging
漏洞示例: MintingHub.buyExpiredCollateral() can remove collateral from a challenged position, so a challenger receives no reward for challenging a near-expiry position. A position owner can adjust price high 3.01 days before expiry (3-day cooldown), then use buyExpiredCollateral to repay debt and remove collateral, leaving the challenger with a loss while minting unbacked ZCHF.

类型名: Authorization gap mints unbacked stablecoin supply
漏洞名称: Small challenge time can be abused
漏洞示例: MintingHub.openPosition() accepts an arbitrary _challengeSeconds with no minimum. If the challenge phase time is 0 or very small, a challenge via bid() immediately satisfies `block.timestamp <= _challenge.start + phase` is false, so _finishChallenge runs and the challenger receives all collateral for free; attacker mints `limit` from the origin position tokens for free.

类型名: Peg-stabilizing reserve mints fresh stablecoin to cover liquidation losses, creating an inflationary insolvency cascade
漏洞名称: _finishChallenge Does NOT Separate Interest Funds From Bid
漏洞示例: MintingHub._finishChallenge transfers only `offer` from the bidder (L312: DEURO.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), offer)) and has no maxInterest parameter, contrary to the spec's `offer + interest`. Challenger reward, principal, and interest all draw from the single `offer` pool, so when offer covers principal but not principal+interest the system calls coverLoss, bearing loss the bidder should have paid; no MEV protection on interest accrual.

类型名: Peg-stabilizing reserve mints fresh stablecoin to cover liquidation losses, creating an inflationary insolvency cascade
漏洞名称: Reserve Depletion Cascade Risk
漏洞示例: When the reserve is depleted, _effectiveReservePPM reduces proportionally so _repayPrincipalNet in forceSale requires the buyer to cover nearly the full principal; combined with coverLoss() drawing from a depleted reserve (minting dEURO via _withdrawFromReserve), a cascade of liquidations could create permanent bad debt and dEURO inflation.

类型名: Peg-stabilizing reserve mints fresh stablecoin to cover liquidation losses, creating an inflationary insolvency cascade
漏洞名称: Reserve depletion cascade can leave permanent bad debt
漏洞示例: When the reserve is depleted, _effectiveReservePPM reduces proportionally so _repayPrincipalNet in Position.forceSale() requires the buyer to cover nearly the full principal. Combined with loss coverage via coverLoss, a cascade of liquidations during reserve depletion can leave the system with permanent bad debt (insolvency).

类型名: Bad debt from liquidation never burned against equity, leaving unbacked stablecoin in circulation
漏洞名称: Untracked Bad Debt / System Health
漏洞示例: When a collateral price drops too fast and keepers cannot/don't force cash out perpetuals, positions are liquidated leaving bad debt; uncovered minted stablecoins become partially backed and when a new HA enters at the current rate the virtual loss converts into actual bad debt. The protocol neither tracks nor handles bad debt, and no function exists to query system health.

类型名: Bad debt from liquidation never burned against equity, leaving unbacked stablecoin in circulation
漏洞名称: forceSale Does Not Account for Bad Debt
漏洞示例: forceSale liquidates an expired position and checks `if (proceeds + availableReserve >= minted)`. When the full collateral is bought but is worth less than the debt, the position has bad debt but the system never calls Frankencoin.coverLoss()/coverloss() to burn ZCHF from equity. The unbacked ZCHF stays in circulation causing ZCHF to depeg and FPS price to be overstated.

漏洞名称: Fee-on-Transfer Collateral Breaks Position and Challenge Accounting

Position._adjust passes `newCollateral` to _setPrice instead of actual balance (inflated price bounds); MintingHub.challenge stores _collateralAmount but holds less (cross-challenger collateral theft); PositionRoller.roll two-hop transfer deducts fees twice and reverts (DoS).

漏洞名称: Rebasing Collateral Tokens Break Challenge Accounting

A downward rebase of the collateral token decreases actual collateral without updating these values, making full challenge settlement impossible (position cannot hold enough collateral to cover all concurrent challenges) — stuck challenges and unliquidatable positions.

类型名: Coverage-ratio / minted-supply accounting desync creates phantom backing for the stablecoin
漏洞名称: Burning AgTokens in BondingCurve Does Not Update stocksUsers
漏洞示例: The BondingCurve contract burns AgTokens received when users buy tokens but never updates the stocksUsers accounting variable (regular burn operations also skip it). The protocol coverage ratio can be miscomputed much higher than reality, creating bad debt through the accounting mismatch.

类型名: Supply↔backing ledger desync from un-reconciled direct burns and external/stale balances
漏洞名称: Minting revenue RToken dilutes backingBuffer in forwardRevenue()
漏洞示例: BackingManager.forwardRevenue() mints rToken for excess collateral using needed = basketsNeeded.mul(FIX_ONE + backingBuffer) and rToken.mint(basketsHeld.bottom - needed), but does not preserve the backingBuffer. E.g. with buffer 5% and 1100 baskets held, minting reduces the buffer to ~4.7%, leaving the RToken more prone to undercollateralization.

类型名: Supply↔backing ledger desync from un-reconciled direct burns and external/stale balances
漏洞名称: Risk of being under collateralized after calling reward()
漏洞示例: After reward() is called, all excess value above what is needed to collateralize lvlUSD is sent to the treasury, leaving the vault value equal to lvlUSD value with no buffer. Near-term price updates (e.g. Morpho bad debt) can then drop asset value below circulating lvlUSD, making lvlUSD under-collateralized with little incentive to mint until the peg recovers.

类型名: Supply↔backing ledger desync from un-reconciled direct burns and external/stale balances
漏洞名称: reward does not account for an under-peg scenario
漏洞示例: RewardsManager.getAccruedYield computes accrued = total - vaultShares using raw asset balances (totalForAsset.convertDecimalsDown) without considering whether the underlying asset is under-peg (price < $1). When an asset is under-peg its actual value is lower than the calculated amount, over-allocating accrued yield to the treasury and leaving lvlUSD insufficiently collateralized on a sharp price drop.

类型名: Bad debt from liquidation never burned against equity, leaving unbacked stablecoin in circulation
漏洞名称: No Functionality to Recover From Bridge Failure
漏洞示例: ZCHF minted via the StablecoinBridge is backed by an external CHF stablecoin. If that stablecoin de-pegs to zero, burning ZCHF through the bridge yields no value and there is no mechanism to update accounting so Equity can absorb the loss. Governance cannot vote to burn the unbacked ZCHF in Equity, leaving unbacked Frankencoin in circulation and causing ZCHF to de-peg below 1 CHF.

类型名: Privileged oracle/component reroute drains reserve at corrupted par value
漏洞名称: Problematic Revocation of a Collateral
漏洞示例: StableMaster.revokeCollateral() transfers all pool funds to a settlement contract and freezes rates. Because claims are settled at frozen rates over a claim window, AgUSD holders can claim collateral at stale favorable prices when the real price rises (e.g. WETH doubles), and an attacker can front-run revokeCollateral() to move the pool balance via flashloan/external exchange so almost nothing reaches the settlement contract, causing SLPs/HAs to lose funds.

类型名: Degenerate oracle-failure price (0 / FIX_MAX) triggers fire-sale of the reserve
漏洞名称: pegPrice is always 1
漏洞示例: SFraxEthCollateral.tryPrice() always returns pegPrice = targetPerRef() which is FIX_ONE, so a depeg cannot be detected. frxETH cannot be redeemed for ETH via Frax, so it is necessary to check whether frxETH (ref) has depegged from ETH (target).

大类: C3 供应↔背书记账缺陷
类型名: Supply↔backing ledger desync from un-reconciled direct burns and external/stale balances
漏洞名称: Calculated rewards may be inaccurate if underlying depegs
漏洞示例: RewardsManager.getAccruedYield() sums _getTotalAssets() per asset in terms of the strategy's underlying token rather than lvlUSD, assuming each underlying is 1:1 USD. If an underlying depegs, this overvalues held assets and accrued yield, causing reward() to pull more assets out than it should and leaving lvlUSD under-collateralized.

类型名: Sub-peg collateral lets users mint/issue the stablecoin (or redeem) at par, arbitraging the peg deviation against backers
漏洞名称: RSR stakers are vulnerable to peg price arbitrage
漏洞示例: Each collateral plugin has a defaultThreshold; RToken issuance is not disabled while the observed target/ref deviation is below it (e.g. issuance only pauses when BTC/WBTC < 0.98 with 2% threshold). When BTC/WBTC drops below peg but above pegBottom, a user can issue RTokens with less target backing than required; RSR overcollateralization then makes them whole, transferring losses to RSR stakers. Fix introduces an issuance premium in BasketHandler.

类型名: Sub-peg collateral lets users mint/issue the stablecoin (or redeem) at par, arbitraging the peg deviation against backers
漏洞名称: RSR stakers are vulnerable to peg price arbitrage
漏洞示例: Each collateral plugin has a defaultThreshold; RToken issuance is not disabled while the observed target/ref deviation is below it (e.g. issuance only pauses when BTC/WBTC < 0.98 with 2% threshold). When BTC/WBTC drops below peg but above pegBottom, a user can issue RTokens with less target backing than required; RSR overcollateralization then makes them whole, transferring losses to RSR stakers. 类型名: Sub-peg collateral lets users mint/issue the stablecoin (or redeem) at par, arbitraging the peg deviation against backers
漏洞名称: Missing !fullyCollateralized() soft-default check allows issuing RTokens at a discount
漏洞示例: In CurveAppreciatingRTokenFiatCollateral and CurveAppreciatingRTokenMetapoolCollateral, the inner RToken readiness is checked only via isReady() (status SOUND), which is insufficient: after the inner RToken switches to a new reference basket, isReady() can return true while the inner RToken is still undercollateralized. During recollateralization the outer RToken can then be issued at a discount, injecting bad debt and causing loss to outer RToken holders/stakers. The check must also include fullyCollateralized().

类型名: Redemption honeypot during undercollateralization / appreciation sandwich on the peg price step
漏洞名称: Custom redemption can be used to get more than RToken value, when an upwards depeg occurs
漏洞示例: redeemCustom lets a holder redeem against previous baskets assuming they are never worth more than target. If a basket collateral X depegs upwards (worth 2c) and the basket switches to backup Y, an attacker redeems half-current/half-previous (0.5X+0.5Y) worth 1.5c per RToken, capturing value meant for revenue traders. FiatCollateral only marks IFFY then SOUND, and redeem checks only fullyCollateralized.

类型名: Collateral-token behavior drift breaks backing accounting
漏洞名称: No SafeERC20 on External Token Interactions
位置: Position.sol, MintingHub.sol, PositionRoller.sol (14 raw transfer calls)
漏洞示例: Position, MintingHub, and PositionRoller use raw .transfer()/.transferFrom() on arbitrary collateral tokens (14 raw calls) instead of SafeERC20. Tokens that conditionally return `false` instead of reverting silently fail, leaving the system inconsistent; the openPosition admission check cannot catch conditional false-returns.

类型名: Authorization gap mints unbacked stablecoin supply
漏洞名称: Implicit Infinite Allowance — Compromised Minter Is System-Wide Drain Risk
漏洞示例: The DecentralizedEURO.allowance() override grants type(uint256).max allowance between all registered minters, positions, and the reserve. A single compromised minter can call transferFrom to drain dEURO from ALL other minters, positions, and the reserve; active minters cannot be revoked, only vetoed during the application period.

类型名: Authorization gap mints unbacked stablecoin supply
漏洞名称: Missing position check leads to unrestricted minting
漏洞示例: MintingHub.launchChallenge (L186-L117) never verifies that the position is registered with Frankencoin or owned by the MintingHub. An attacker passes a malicious position contract, controlling challenge.end and the returned collateral, so a challenge can be started and ended in the same transaction; _end() then calls Frankencoin.notifyLoss (L244) which mints/transfers ZCHF to the attacker.

类型名: Authorization gap mints unbacked stablecoin supply
漏洞名称: Token frontend can impersonate anyone
漏洞示例: ControllerToken's transfer_withCaller and mintTo_withCaller (onlyFrontend) forward an arbitrary caller parameter as the acting address. Since the Token Frontend address is owner-settable, a malicious frontend can impersonate any address to transfer tokens, or impersonate a System Account with unlimited allowance to mint unlimited tokens.

类型名: Privileged oracle/component reroute drains reserve at corrupted par value
漏洞名称: Potential Exploits from Guardian Role
漏洞示例: The Guardian role (intended for emergency multisig) can extract funds via four privileged functions: PoolManager.addStrategy() (add malicious strategy receiving collateral), StableMaster.setOracle() and BondingCurve.changeOracle() (set malicious oracle to manipulate price and drain via cashOutAmount), and RewardsDistributor.setStakingContract() (redirect all reward tokens). These should be Governor-only.

类型名: Authorization gap mints unbacked stablecoin supply
漏洞名称: Initializer can be called more than one time
漏洞示例: Position.initialize() has only onlyOwner, but the custom Ownable's _setOwner() only checks `require(newOwner != address(0))` instead of `oldOwner != address(0)`, so initialize() can be called multiple times. An attacker can re-initialize with a malicious parent contract so that `price = parent.price()` is inflated, then mint excess ZCHF.

类型名: Authorization gap mints unbacked stablecoin supply
漏洞名称: Collusion between minter and capper may lead to arbitrary minting
漏洞示例: In Token_v1.sol, mint() is protected by the notMoreThanCapacity modifier, but a minter colluding with a capper can call cap() to raise the cap arbitrarily and then mint unlimited tokens, diluting token value.

类型名: 发行上限/背书量按 balanceOf 计量(可绕过)
原一级类别: 5 资产记账与供应完整性缺陷
漏洞名称: Bridge's Risk Exposure Limit Can Be Circumvented
漏洞示例: StablecoinBridge.mintInternal enforces exposure via `require(chf.balanceOf(address(this)) <= limit)`. This relies on the external chf token returning a correct balanceOf; a malicious/upgraded chf could return 0 or burn a specific address's balance, so the limit is bypassed and an unbounded amount of Frankencoin can be minted through the bridge. Fixed by adding internal accounting of minted tokens.

类型名: Collateral-refresh revert bricks the whole peg-keeping engine
漏洞名称: EURFiatCollateral.sol: refresh() may revert
漏洞示例: refresh() of an asset should never revert as it disables an RToken (asset registry calls it every refresh; priceable is set false on revert). In EURFiatCollateral, refresh() may revert when p2 == 0 due to a division by zero in p1.div(p2). Fix: only perform the division if p2 > 0.

类型名: Collateral-refresh revert bricks the whole peg-keeping engine
漏洞名称: RToken permanently insolvent/unusable if a single collateral in the basket behaves unexpectedly
漏洞示例: If one basket collateral (e.g. a cToken that self-destructs/upgrades) reverts on calls, CTokenFiatCollateral.refresh() (calls exchangeRateCurrent) reverts, so AssetRegistry.refresh() reverts, bricking issue/vest/redeem/manageTokens/poke/withdraw. Worse, unregister() calls basketHandler.quantity -> coll.refPerTok which also reverts, so the bad collateral cannot even be removed, permanently locking all other (good) collateral.

类型名: Degenerate oracle-failure price (0 / FIX_MAX) triggers fire-sale of the reserve
漏洞名称: User can't redeem from RToken based on CurveStableRTokenMetapoolCollateral when any underlying collateral of paired RToken's price oracle is offline (timeout)
漏洞示例: CurveStableRTokenMetapoolCollateral.tryPairedPrice() returns pairedAssetRegistry.toAsset(pairedToken).price(). When any underlying collateral oracle of the paired RToken times out, RTokenAsset.price returns high=FIX_MAX (non-zero low), so refresh() either fails the assert(low==0) branch or reverts in _anyDepeggedOutsidePool, blocking redemption and risking a depeg/run.

类型名: Collateral-refresh revert bricks the whole peg-keeping engine
漏洞名称: Dutch auctions can fail to settle if any other collateral in the basket behaves unexpectedly
漏洞示例: DutchTrade bid() calls BackingManager.settleTrade() which chains into rebalance() inside a try/catch that treats empty error data as out-of-gas. But empty reverts also come from require() with no message or token calls (e.g. USDT/BNB approve()). If any basket collateral's ERC20 produces an empty revert during rebalance, settlement reverts and the Dutch auction cannot settle at a fair price.

类型名: Flash-mint / atomic mint-burn assumption leaves unbacked supply if the burn leg fails
漏洞名称: Flash-mint via PositionRoller can leave unbacked dEURO if burn fails
漏洞示例: PositionRoller flash-mints dEURO (PositionRoller.sol L77, L133) and relies on atomic mint+burn within one transaction. The Roller is a registered minter with implicit infinite allowance, so if the terminating burn ever fails, unbacked dEURO would exist. No invariant currently enforces that the Roller never holds dEURO between transactions.

类型名: Reentrancy/hook during liquidation mints unbacked or mispriced stable units
漏洞名称: Double Entry Point Protection Can Be Insufficient
漏洞示例: Position.withdraw guards double-entry-point collateral tokens with `require(balance == _collateralBalance())` after transfer. If the collateral has a pre-transfer hook, the owner withdraws via the token's second entry point; inside the hook a reentrant adjust(2000,2000,1) deposits equal collateral and mints, so the post-check passes even though collateral was withdrawn, leaving the position undercollateralized (e.g. 2000 ZCHF minted against 1000 collateral).

类型名: Reentrancy/hook during liquidation mints unbacked or mispriced stable units
漏洞名称: Reentrant Collateral Could Mint During Liquidation
漏洞示例: notifyChallengeSucceeded() reduces challengedAmount, sends collateral to bidder, then restricts minting for 3 days — in that order. With reentrant (ERC-777) collateral, the bid() transfer gives control to the attacker before minting is restricted; since challengedAmount is now 0 (noChallenge) and 3 days passed (noCooldown), she re-enters and mints `limit` ZCHF at the inflated liquidationPrice, minting at an incorrectly high price and causing losses.

类型名: Liquidation evasion/blocking on an undercollateralized position leaves it open to keep minting unbacked stablecoin
漏洞名称: Bids Could Be Reverted by Frontrunning
漏洞示例: MintingHub.bid checks `if (expectedSize != challenge.size) revert UnexpectedSize();`. A challenger can front-run bids by repeatedly calling splitChallenge(challengeNumber, minCollateral + R) each block, changing challenge.size so every incoming bid reverts. With no competing bids the endTime is never extended, and at end() the challenger buys >1M ZCHF of collateral for 1 ZCHF, causing a massive system loss.

类型名: Self-referential backing valuation corrupts the unit-of-account's own price
漏洞名称: ETH+/ETH Curve pool is vulnerable to read-only reentrancy
漏洞示例: CurveAppreciatingRTokenSelfReferentialCollateral uses the ETH+/ETH Curve pool's get_virtual_price() as its refPerTok() exchange rate. The pool converts WETH to ETH, so remove_liquidity() triggers the ETH receiver callback before self.D is updated while totalSupply() has already decreased, inflating get_virtual_price(). An attacker reenters to refresh() and mint RTokens at a discount via RToken.issue() with inflated Curve LP tokens, then redeems for more LP tokens than provided.

类型名: Liquidation evasion/blocking on an undercollateralized position leaves it open to keep minting unbacked stablecoin
漏洞名称: The expectedPrice can be abused
漏洞示例: MintingHub.challenge() reverts with UnexpectedPrice() if `position.price() != expectedPrice`. An attacker can front-run and lower the position price by 1 wei to make all challenges revert; via _adjustPrice (lowering price doesn't restrict minting) they can set a very high price (bounded only by the _setPrice sanity check) and mint cheaply.

类型名: Redemption honeypot during undercollateralization / appreciation sandwich on the peg price step
漏洞名称: Baited by redemption during undercollateralization (no issuance, just transfer)
漏洞示例: A user's redeem tx can be reordered by a malicious actor: they refreshBasket in the same block that the original collateral (tokenA) is disabled (kicking in backup tokenB), making the protocol undercollateralized, then send 1 wei tokenB to the BackingManager. The victim's redemption of 100k rTokens then settles for only a fraction of tokenB because withdrawals are prorata-bounded by BackingManager balance during undercollateralization. Duplicate of M-04.

类型名: Redemption honeypot during undercollateralization / appreciation sandwich on the peg price step
漏洞名称: Redemptions during undercollateralization can be hot-swapped to steal all funds
漏洞示例: During recollateralization/basket switch, a malicious validator orders txs to honeypot a victim's redeem: buy lots of tokenA and send to BackingManager, call manageTokens to flash-issue RToken (inflating totalSupply and the redemption battery cap), let tokenA disable so backup tokenB kicks in, send tokenB dust, then order the victim's redeem so they redeem all 1M RToken for tokenB dust.

类型名: Redemption honeypot during undercollateralization / appreciation sandwich on the peg price step
漏洞名称: The Furnace#melt() is vulnerable to sandwich attacks
漏洞示例: Furnace.melt() increases RToken's issue/redeem price (basket rate) in a single step at each payout. A flash-loan sandwich buys RToken cheap, calls RToken.redeem() (which invokes melt() first, raising the price), and sells, capturing the appreciation that should accrue to long-term holders; alternatively issuing 1-n blocks before a payout and redeeming after yields outsized APR.

类型名: 维度/单位错配
漏洞名称: Cached Rate May Be Wrong
漏洞示例: OracleMulti._readAll() caches the last Chainlink circuit pair to finalize the Uniswap rate, but the constructor allows the last Chainlink and Uniswap pairs to differ. With a Chainlink circuit (UNI-WBTC, WBTC-USD) and Uniswap circuit (UNI-WETH), the WBTC-USD rate is cached and reused in the if (uniFinalCurrency > 0) branch instead of the needed WETH-USD rate, producing an incorrect price.

类型名: 维度/单位错配
漏洞名称: MorphoNonFiatCollateral is deployed with incorrect price feed
漏洞示例: The deploy_morpho_aavev2_plugin.ts script configures both chainlinkFeed and targetUnitChainlinkFeed of MorphoNonFiatCollateral to the same wBTC/BTC feed address. This prices the maWBTC collateral at the wBTC->BTC exchange rate (~1) in the USD unit of account, so 1 wBTC is assumed worth 1 USD instead of ~28,000 USD.

类型名: 维度/单位错配
漏洞名称: MorphoNonFiatCollateral works like self-referential collaterals
漏洞示例: MorphoNonFiatCollateral.tryPrice() works like a self-referential collateral: it expects chainlinkFeed to be a {UoA/ref} feed but for wBTC there is no wBTC/USD Chainlink feed, and pegPrice is not multiplied by the chainlinkFeed price (unlike the correct CTokenNonFiatCollateral.tryPrice() which multiplies pegPrice by targetUnitChainlinkFeed).

类型名: 维度/单位错配
漏洞名称: longToken Assumed To Be The indexToken
漏洞示例: In the _get function the price of the long token is taken as the price of the index token, but not all GM markets have the long token as the index token. For the DOGE/USD GM market (Ether is the long token), the price of ETH is returned as the price of DOGE, producing a dramatically inaccurate collateral price.

类型名: 维度/单位错配
原一级类别: 5 资产记账与供应完整性缺陷
漏洞名称: CTokenV3Collateral._underlyingRefPerTok should use the decimals from underlying Comet
漏洞示例: CTokenV3Collateral._underlyingRefPerTok() calls shiftl_toFix(exchangeRate(), -int8(erc20Decimals)) using the CusdcV3Wrapper decimals, but exchangeRate() is scaled by 10**underlyingComet.decimals(). The mismatched decimals (erc20Decimals vs comet.decimals()) produce an incorrect ref/tok rate.
